data.titulo: Part 8—Yuma Yize Mbimbiliya Hiyinambe Yakupwa Yamwenemwene
data.contenido:
Mbimbiliya yishi kusolola wika yishima yamwenemwene yize yapwile ku matangwa akunyima ka, alioze, yinambe nawa hakutwala ku yuma yize muyikapwa kulutwe lia matangwa. Atu kechi kuhasa kulumbununa yuma yize muyiza kulutwe lia matangwa. Kashika yetwe tunanyingika ngwo Mbimbiliya yili Liji lia Zambi. Yika Mbimbiliya yinambe hakutwala kulutwe lia matangwa?

Yinambe hakutwala ku yimwe jita yinene ya Zambi. Ha jita yacho, Zambi makachiza upi weswe hano hashi ni atu api, alioze makafunga atu waze akumwononokena. Mwanangana wa Zambi, Yesu Kristu, makasela ushindakenyo hanga atu ja Zambi apwe ni ukulungunga hamwe ni uwahililo, nawa hanga ayo achine kuyiza chipwe kufwa.

Yetwe mutuhasa kuwahilila ngwo Zambi makalinga paraisu yaha hano hashi, nyi ngwami? Alioze, yetwe chatutamba kulinga chimwe chuma, nyi tunazange kutwama mu paraisu yacho. Ha chishima cha kusongo mu mukanda uno, mutulilongesa yize chatutamba kulinga mba tutambule yiwape yinji yize Zambi anatulikila waze akumwononokena. Kashika, tanga CHIHANDA 8 hanga uwane yuma yize Mbimbiliya hiyinambe hakutwala ku matangwa a kulutwe.

YIKA yena unamono hano? Ewa, chimwe chizavu cha maswalale ali ha tuvwalu atoma. Alioze, tala kuze ayo anakatuka. Tuvwalu kanakatuka mwilu mu malelwa! Shina mwilu tuvwalu atwamamo?

Ka, wano hi tuvwalu amwenemwene ko. Yetwe tunanyingika ngwo tuvwalu kechi kuhasa kuzomboka helu lia malelwa, nyi ngwami? Alioze, Mbimbiliya yinambe hakutwala kuli tuvwalu mu malilu. Yena unanyingika mumu liaka?

Mumu ku mashimbu akunyima tujita te kakwendela ha tuvwalu hanga aliase jita. Kashika, Mbimbiliya yinambe hakutwala kuli atu waze ali ha tuvwalu anasunuka mwilu, hanga yisolole ngwo Zambi masa jita ni atu a hano hashi. Yena unanyingika jina lia chihela cha jita yacho? Armagedone. Jita yacho muyihwisa upi weswe hano hashi.

Yesu Mwe makasongwela tujita ha jita ya Armagedone. Euluka ngwo Yehova hanasakula Yesu hanga apwe mwanangana mu wanangana Wenyi. Kashika, Yesu anazala chipangula cha mwanangana. Nawa mukwale unasolola ngwo iye makashaha akwa kole ja Zambi eswe. Shina yetwe chatutamba kukomoka hakwivwa ngwo Zambi manongesa atu eswe api?

Tala kunyima ha Chishima 10. Yika yena unamonoho? Chochene, Sanga Linene lia meya lize linakashaha atu api. Iya unakaneha Sanga Linene lia Meya? Yehova Zambi. Haliapwila tala ha Chishima 15. Yika yinapuho? Sondome ni Ngomora hayocha ni kahia kaze Yehova anakatuma.

Funa ha Chishima 33. Tala yize yinapu kuli tuvwalu ni matemba a jita ja A-Engitu. Iya wapukula meya apwahaha hanga eze hali ayo? Yehova. Iye kanakachilinga hanga akalile atu jenyi. Tala ha Chishima 76. Ahaze yena mumona chize Yehova anakecha atu jenyi, A-Izalele, hanga aanongese ha mukunda wa upi wo.

Kashika, yetwe kanda tukomoka hakwivwa ngwo Yehova matuma chizavu cha maswalale a mwilu hanga ahwise upi weswe hano hashi. Alioze nyonga kama chize yino muyikalumbunuka! Fukula lifwo likwo hanga utale.Usolwelo 16:16; 19:11-16. Yihula ya Longeso

TALA kama mitondo ayi yisuku-yisuku, ni yitemo yipema ni milundu yinene-yinene. Chihela chino chili chipema, nyi ngwami? Tala kayi kanalila ha kwoko lia kanuke au. Nawa tala ndumba ni tuvwalu anamana ha mwambu auze. Yena unazange kutwama mu chimwe chihela ngwe achi?

Zambi kanazange hanga yena utwame miaka yeswe hano hashi, mu paraisu. Nawa iye kaso kuzanga hanga yena uyize ngwe chize atu anayiza musono. Yenayino Mbimbiliya yinalakenya kuli waze makatwama mu paraisu yaha, ngwo: ‘Zambi makapwa hamwe no. Kufwa, mbimbi, chipwe yikola kuyichi kapwako nawa. Yuma yikulu muyikahwa.’ Yesu makasela ushindakenyo hanga yuma yacho yipema yikapwe hano hashi. Yena unanyingika shimbu lika? Chochene, muze iye mahwisa upi ni atu api eswe hano hashi. Euluka ngwo, muze Yesu apwile hano hashi, iye te kakuwuka atu waze te akwete yikola yamutapu weswe, nawa kanakahindwisa atu mu ufwe. Yesu kanakalinga yuma yino hanga asolole yize iye makalinga hano hashi, muze meza ngwe Mwanangana mu wanangana wa Zambi.

Nyonga kama chiseke hakupwa mu paraisu yaha hano hashi! Yesu hamuwika ni amwe atu akusakula, mayula mu malilu. Akwa kuyula jacho makafunga atu eswe hano hashi, hanga akapwe ni uwahililo. Tutalenu yize chatamba kulinga mba Zambi atwehe mwono wa mutolo mu paraisu yenyi yaha.Usolwelo 21:3, 4; 5:9, 10; 14:1-3. Yihula ya Longeso

data.titulo: Kuchi Mutuhasa Kutwama ku Miaka Yeswe
data.contenido:
YENA unanyingika yize kanuke au ni masepa jenyi anatange? Ewa, mukanda unowene yena unatanga—Mukanda Wami wa Yishima ya Mbimbiliya. Nawa ayo kanatanga chishima achi—“Kuchi Mutuhasa Kutwama Ku Miaka Yeswe.”

Yena unanyingika yize ayo analilongesa? Chitangu, yetwe chatutamba kunyingika hakutwala kuli Yehova ni Mwanenyi Yesu, nyi tunazange kutwama ku miaka yeswe. Mbimbiliya yinambe ngwo: ‘Chenacho chatamba kulinga hanga tukatwame ku miaka yeswe. Lilongese hakutwala kuli Zambi wamwenemwene, ni Mwanenyi yoze iye atumine hano hashi, Yesu Kristu.’

Kuchi mutuhasa kulilongesa hakutwala kuli Yehova Zambi ni Mwanenyi Yesu? Yimwe jila yili, kutanga Mukanda Wami wa Yishima ya Mbimbiliya, chize ku uputukilo ndo kusongo. Mukanda uno wakuhanjika chinji hakutwala kuli Yehova ni Yesu, nyi ngwami? Nawa wakuhanjika hakutwala ku yuma yize ayo anakalinga ni yize malinga. Alioze, chatutamba kulinga yuma yikwo nawa, hi kutanga mukanda uno wika ko.

Yena unamono mukanda ukwo au uli hashi? Yili Mbimbiliya. Eta kuli umwe mutu hanga akutangile yihanda ya mu Mbimbiliya yize yinahanjika hakutwala ku yishima yino yili mu mukanda uno. Mbimbiliya yinatulumbunwina yuma yeswe yize yetwe tunafupu hanga tunyingike chize chatamba kulingila kanawa Yehova ni chize mutupwa ni mwono wa mutolo. Kashika, yetwe chatutamba kupwa ni ndako ya kulilongesa Mbimbiliya matangwa eswe.

Alioze, hi kulilongesa wika ko hakutwala kuli Yehova ni Yesu Kristu ka. Yetwe mutuhasa kupwa ni yinyingi yinji hakutwala kuli ayo ni ya malongeso jo, alioze chipwe chocho tuchikuhasa kupwa ni mwono wa mutolo. Yena unanyingika yize chatamba kulinga nawa?

Yetwe chatutamba kutwama nikulita ni yuma yize tunalilongesa. Yena uneuluka Yundase Ka-Keriote? Iye te umwe wa kuli 12 waze Yesu asakwile hanga apwe apostolo jenyi. Yundase kanakapwa ni yinyingi yinji hakutwala kuli Yehova ni Yesu. Alioze, yika yinakapwa kuli iye? Kanakapwa ni chipululu, kashika anakakunjika Yesu kuli akwa kole jenyi, ha 30 a mbongo ja prata. Kashika, Yundase kechi kamwaha mwono wa mutolo.

Uneuluka Ngehaze, lunga yoze twalilongesanga ha Chishima 69? Iye yazanga kupwa ni amwe mahina ni mbongo jambala. Kashika, iye yahanjika mahuza hanga ahase kupwa ni yuma yacho. Alioze, Yehova yamumwesa lamba. Nawa ni yetwe nyi twehuka ku shimbi jenyi iye matumwesa lamba.

Alioze, kunakapwa atu anji apema waze anakalingila Yehova ni ushishiko weswe. Yetwe tunazange kupwa ngwe ayo, nyi ngwami? Kanuke Samuele kali chimwe chilweza chipema chize yetwe mutuhasa kukaula. Euluka ngwo, muze twalilongesanga Chishima 55, iye te uchili wika ni miaka yiwana hanji yitano muze aputukile kulingila Yehova, mu tabernakulu yenyi. Kashika, chipwe ngwe ni yena uchili kanuke chinji, nihindu muhasa kulingila Yehova.

Chamwenemwene, mutu yoze yetwe eswe tunazange kukaula mwe Yesu Kristu. Chipwe muze iye te uchili kanuke, ngwe chize twamonanga ha Chishima 87, iye kayile mu tembele ni kuhanjika ni akwo hakutwala kuli Tato wa mu malilu. Tukaulenu chilweza chenyi. Twambujolenu kuli atu anji hakutwala kuli Zambi wetu mupema Yehova, ni Mwanenyi Yesu Kristu. Nyi twalinga yuma yino, mutukahasa kutwama ku miaka yeswe mu paraisu yaha ya Zambi hano hashi.Yoano 17:3; Masamu 145:1-21. Yihula ya Longeso
